---
name: "e2e-132609 bounded inference probe"
description: "Fork-only Copilot inference entitlement probe; one disclosed status comment on fork PR2."

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  roles: all

if: github.repository == 'YuliiaKovalova/runtime'

permissions:
  contents: read
  copilot-requests: write

timeout-minutes: 5
max-turns: 3

engine:
  id: copilot
  bare: true

network:
  allowed:
    - defaults

tools:
  bash:
    - "safeoutputs:*"
  edit: false

safe-outputs:
  report-failure-as-issue: false
  add-comment:
    max: 1
    target: "2"
  messages:
    footer: "> AI-generated by GitHub Copilot. Inference-only probe, not production E2E proof."
  missing-tool:
    create-issue: false
  missing-data:
    create-issue: false
  report-incomplete:
    create-issue: false
  noop:
    max: 1
    report-as-issue: false
---

This is an AI-generated, fork-only inference entitlement probe, not a build
failure analysis or production workflow test.

Do not read repository files, execute other shell commands, or call external
APIs. Submit the final intended status comment with this exact safe-output CLI
command once, then stop:

```bash
safeoutputs add_comment --body "e2e-132609 inference entitlement confirmed. This verifies only fork Actions-token Copilot inference, not the production build-failure workflows. No runtime or Azure build was requested."
```
